remarks: New Construction!! Spectacular Modern Farmhouse. 4 levels of finished living space. This 4 bed, 4.5 bath is the ultimate family home. A chefs kitchen w/luxury JennAir built in appliances & hood, custom cabinetry, waterfall island, designer light fixtures & dining area. Impressive great room w/10ft ceilings, white oak wood flrs, crown moldings & mill work. Lrg Mudrm w/custom cabinets & designer powder room complete the first floor. Upstairs is the primary suite w/ his & hers walk-in closets & en suite bath w/ dual sink vanity, double shower w/bench & custom linen cabinet. The 2nd bedroom has an en-suite bath. On the third floor two secondary bedrms share a full bath. Walk out on to your rooftop deck. The 2nd flr laundry rm has ample cabinets for storage. Through the great room doors is a modern glass surround deck, a beautifully manicured yard w/mature plantings & wifi sprinkler irrigation system w/app controlled by weather or wifi, oversized 1 car garage & stonewall tiered grounds. Impressive finished LL has a full bath & extra storage, Whole house audio wired for entertainment. Central vac. Constructed w/ the finest building materials: Gessi fixtures, Modern Form lighting, Armani tile, Manhattan Marble, New Zealand plank siding, Cedar shingle roofing/siding & brush nickel gutters. Greenwich in town living: steps to dining , schools, shopping, entertainment, parks, library, harbor, highways & train. Easy access to NYC.
